**Upgrade before you store a passkey.** This release adds the `passkey` field type. Older TypeVault releases treat an entry holding a passkey as tampered, and one such entry makes a whole sealed grant, or a whole live bulk read through an older daemon or SDK, fail, not just that entry. Before a passkey lands in a vault others share (through `typevault set`, a Bitwarden import, or TypeClaw's `browser_passkey`), upgrade every teammate's `typevault` CLI and every SDK grant consumer (TypeClaw and any other program that reads grants) to this release or later.
